nodes.label: AMPM Platform Design Package
nodes.rationale: Drafts, version 0.2, 25 October 2026. Split in two parts so AMPM can review without a technical background: Part A (A1-A6) is written for AMPM to review and decide, Part B (B0-B9) is the developer drafts behind it, for reference. AMPM answered all 25 questions on 25 October; the answers are applied to every draft (each opens with a Changes from AMPM's decisions section) and stamped on every assumption. Eleven points remain to confirm; nothing is signed off yet.

nodes.label: Decision brief (A2, review/decision-brief.md)
nodes.rationale: The short version of the package, now with AMPM's answers under every question and the eleven points still to confirm; AMPM's task is to confirm the remaining eleven points.

nodes.label: Your brief, annotated (A3, review/annotated-brief.md)
nodes.rationale: AMPM's five documents reproduced in full with every finding placed at the passage it concerns, so AMPM reads its own text with callouts and most findings take a sentence to understand.

nodes.label: Your flowcharts, redrawn (A4, review/redesigned-flowcharts.md)
nodes.rationale: AMPM's two flowcharts and the customer journey, as supplied and as upgraded, with additions in green and changes in amber; AMPM approves the structure or marks boxes to change.

nodes.label: Decisions we need from you (A5, review/open-decisions.md)
nodes.rationale: The 25 questions in plain language with choices, what was assumed, and a box for AMPM's answer; the ten Tier 1 questions are to be answered first.

nodes.label: Assumptions we took (A6, review/assumptions-taken.md)
nodes.rationale: Every assumption made in place of an answer, grouped by theme, with a confirm column for AMPM to tick or correct each line. Generated by assumptions_sheet_build.py.

nodes.label: decision-log.md (B0, generated)
nodes.rationale: AMPM's answer to every question, what it does to each assumption, and the items still to confirm. Generated by decision_log_build.py.

nodes.label: requirements-audit.md (B1)
nodes.rationale: The audit of AMPM's brief: 9 conflicts, 44 gaps, 15 ambiguities, 8 risks, 25 decisions. Findings in sections 4 to 10, the question list in section 11.

nodes.label: decision-register.md (B2, generated)
nodes.rationale: Every assumption indexed by the question it depends on, so that answering a question identifies the assumption lines to confirm or replace. Generated by decision_register_build.py.

nodes.label: user-flows.md (B3)
nodes.rationale: Twelve end-to-end flows with statuses, notifications and screens.

nodes.label: wireframes.md (B4)
nodes.rationale: Screen-by-screen specification, 124 screens, with sketches.

nodes.label: data-model.md (B5)
nodes.rationale: Entity-relationship model, 106 tables in 17 Mermaid diagrams; the diagrams are the source the field matrix is generated from.

nodes.label: permission-matrix.md (B6)
nodes.rationale: Roles, entitlements, visibility classes, transitions, audited actions.

nodes.label: field-matrix.md and field-matrix.csv (B7, generated)
nodes.rationale: Every field: type, validation, editor, visibility, when required, automation. Generated by field_matrix_build.py from the data-model diagrams and field_rules.py.

nodes.label: architecture.md (B8)
nodes.rationale: Technology, hosting, security, backups, maintenance, integration plan.

nodes.label: test-cases.md (B9)
nodes.rationale: 36 acceptance criteria, 208 tests, phase exit packs, test data.

nodes.label: Milestone schedule and cost estimate (not yet drafted)
nodes.rationale: Held until the platform question (Q1) and the volume question (Q15) are answered, because schedule and cost depend on both.

nodes.label: Q1 to Q25 decision questions
nodes.rationale: A decision only AMPM can make; defined in Part A2 and A5 and in requirements-audit.md section 11. Every assumption cites the question it stands in for.

nodes.label: Tier 1 questions (ten)
nodes.rationale: The ten questions AMPM is asked to answer first, ahead of the rest of the 25.

nodes.label: Eleven remaining points to confirm (open items)
nodes.rationale: After AMPM's answers of 25 October, eleven points remain to confirm; they are listed in the decision log and the decision brief, and each has an open-item note in the vault whose status is set to confirmed when AMPM confirms it.

nodes.label: Audit finding codes CF, GP, AM, RK
nodes.rationale: Conflict, gap, ambiguity, risk; defined in requirements-audit.md sections 4 to 10 and placed in context in Part A3.

nodes.label: Assumption codes A, P, T, U, W, V
nodes.rationale: Assumptions made in place of an answer, by theme: data model (A), permissions (P), technology (T), flows (U), screens (W), testing (V). Defined in Part A6 and in section 0 (the assumption register) of each developer draft.

nodes.label: Screen codes PUB, AUTH, DM, CP, TW, GR
nodes.rationale: Screens by area: public site, sign-in, demo, client portal, team workspace, guest RSVP portal; defined in wireframes.md.

nodes.label: AC-nn.m test case identifiers
nodes.rationale: Test cases under acceptance criterion nn; defined in test-cases.md.

nodes.label: Decision propagation chain
nodes.rationale: When AMPM answers a question, the assumption lines that cite it (Part A6 or the decision register) are confirmed or replaced; then the tables, screens and tests that cite those lines; then the generated files are rebuilt. This is why assumptions are indexed by question and why the matrices and registers are generated rather than hand-edited.

nodes.label: Generated files are never edited by hand
nodes.rationale: field-matrix.md and .csv, decision-register.md, review/assumptions-taken.md, decision-log.md, site/index.html and site/brief.html are rebuilt by generators from the diagrams, the assumption registers, the audit's question list and decisions.json; hand edits would be lost on the next rebuild, so the sources are edited and the generators rerun.

nodes.label: field_rules.py
nodes.rationale: Holds the field rules that field_matrix_build.py applies to the data-model diagrams when it rebuilds the field matrix.

nodes.label: apply_decisions.py
nodes.rationale: Stamps AMPM's decisions from decisions.json on every assumption register; run together with decision_log_build.py, then the three other generators.

nodes.label: decisions.json (docs/decisions.json)
nodes.rationale: The machine-readable record of AMPM's decisions; edited when AMPM confirms a remaining point, then apply_decisions.py, decision_log_build.py and the three generators are rerun.

nodes.label: site_build.mjs
nodes.rationale: Rebuilds site/index.html, the whole package as one shareable page; with --brief rebuilds site/brief.html, the decision brief alone. Needs the marked package installed with npm install inside docs/tools.

nodes.label: Published artifact for AMPM (claude.ai/artifact/55fJPFQnnqi8sVVU7FUFcv)
nodes.rationale: The private shareable copy of the package for AMPM; republished after every rebuild so the link stays the same.

nodes.label: Mermaid diagrams
nodes.rationale: Chosen because they render on GitHub, GitLab, VS Code with the Mermaid preview extension, Obsidian, and on the shared page, so one source serves every reader.

nodes.label: app-ampm GitHub account
nodes.rationale: The project's own GitHub account that owns both private repositories; its token is taken from the GitHub CLI keyring by the credential helper whichever gh account is active.

nodes.label: ampm-platform repository
nodes.rationale: Holds the design package, the audit, AMPM's source documents, the generators, and later the code. Also commits .claude/settings.json, .mcp.json, .claude/skills/graphify/, .graphifyignore, CLAUDE.md and graphify-out/.

nodes.label: ampm-vault repository
nodes.rationale: Holds the Obsidian vault in vault/, ignored by the project repository: generated notes, a synced copy of docs/, a copy of reference_docs/, the Obsidian configuration.

nodes.label: Per-repository git identity bound to app-ampm
nodes.rationale: Both repositories carry the app-ampm account's address as their git identity plus the credential helper so that nothing committed in these folders is recorded under another account; checkpoint.sh and vault_sync.py refuse to commit if a repository has no identity of its own. setup_git.sh restores identity, helper, post-commit hook and vault clone after cloning.

nodes.label: git-credential-ampm.sh
nodes.rationale: Credential helper that takes the app-ampm account's token from the GitHub CLI keyring whichever gh account is active.

nodes.label: setup_git.sh
nodes.rationale: Run after cloning to restore the identity, the credential helper, the post-commit hook and the vault clone.

nodes.label: Obsidian vault (vault/)
nodes.rationale: The human-readable record for Obsidian (notes, session journal, build decision records), opened with File, Open folder as vault. Independent of the palace and the graph, which are what a session reads.

nodes.label: vault notes/ (question, assumption, finding, open-item and log notes)
nodes.rationale: One note per question with AMPM's decision, one per assumption with its status, one per audit finding, one per open item, and a log. Open-item and log notes are written once and kept; notes written in Obsidian are kept and committed.

nodes.label: Synced copies of docs/ and reference_docs/ in the vault
nodes.rationale: The vault's docs/ and reference_docs/ are copies that render with their diagrams; documents are edited in the project, not in the vault, because the next sync overwrites the copy.

nodes.label: notes/Sessions/ session journal
nodes.rationale: One note per Claude Code session, created by the SessionStart hook and refreshed at the end of every turn with the requests made (first line of each message), the commits and the files changed; Claude writes the Narrative section at wrap-up with what was decided and why.

nodes.label: notes/Build decisions/ D-nnn records
nodes.rationale: D-nnn records for technical and process decisions taken during the build (context, decision, alternatives, consequences); kept apart from AMPM's own answers, which stay under notes/Decisions/.

nodes.label: new_decision.py
nodes.rationale: Creates a D-nnn build decision record: python3 docs/tools/new_decision.py Title --area area.

nodes.label: AMPM Dashboard.base (Obsidian Bases)
nodes.rationale: Live tables of open items, build decisions, sessions, AMPM's decisions, assumptions and findings, driven by the notes' properties, so it needs no generator.

nodes.label: SessionStart hook
nodes.rationale: At the start of a Claude Code session in this folder it creates the session's journal note (session_journal.py --start) and tells the session what the memory wing and the knowledge graph hold and whether the graph is stale (memory_hook.sh session-start).

nodes.label: Stop hook (.claude/settings.json)
nodes.rationale: At the end of every Claude Code turn it runs checkpoint.sh --hook, which commits and pushes the project if anything changed, then syncs the vault, showing a one-line message only when it committed; also triggers the memory hook.

nodes.label: post-commit hook
nodes.rationale: Installed by setup_git.sh; on every project commit it runs vault_sync.py so the vault follows the project without a manual step.

nodes.label: PreToolUse hook (graphify install --project)
nodes.rationale: Before every search or file read by Claude Code it runs graphify hook-guard, which points the session at the knowledge graph instead of grepping when the graph can answer.

nodes.label: launchd agent com.ampm.vault-sync
nodes.rationale: Every ten minutes runs vault_sync.py --vault-only to commit and push edits made inside Obsidian; definition in docs/tools/; stopped with launchctl bootout gui/$(id -u)/com.ampm.vault-sync.

nodes.label: checkpoint.sh
nodes.rationale: Commits and pushes the project if anything changed, then syncs the vault; --hook form is silent unless it committed; by hand bash docs/tools/checkpoint.sh message commits with your own message. Every checkpoint commit also files new or changed design docs into the MemPalace wing.

nodes.label: vault_sync.py
nodes.rationale: Copies docs/ and reference_docs/ into the vault, rebuilds the generated notes, appends to the day's sync log note, commits and pushes the vault when something changed; --vault-only commits Obsidian edits without touching the project.

nodes.label: vault_build.py
nodes.rationale: Only rebuilds the vault notes, without syncing or committing.

nodes.label: memory_hook.sh
nodes.rationale: session-start mode tells the session what the memory wing and the knowledge graph hold and whether the graph is stale; otherwise (every ten human messages, before compaction, at session end) mines the session transcript into the MemPalace wing ampm in the background.

nodes.label: mempalace mine docs --wing ampm
nodes.rationale: Run on every project commit made by the checkpoint; files new or changed design docs into the same wing as the session transcripts.

nodes.label: MemPalace 3.11
nodes.rationale: Session memory: a local palace in ~/.mempalace holding verbatim text with semantic search and no API calls; the palace itself is not committed and stays on the machine. Used via mempalace search and wake-up, or in a session via the mempalace MCP server (palace_query, palace_exec).

nodes.label: MemPalace wing ampm
nodes.rationale: Holds the transcript of every session run in this folder or its worktrees, and the design docs, so the work of every Claude Code session stays available to the next one.

nodes.label: graphify 0.9
nodes.rationale: Builds the knowledge graph of the design package, the generators and AMPM's source documents; /graphify . builds, /graphify . --update refreshes changed files; graphify query, explain and path answer questions; also exposed as the graphify MCP server.

nodes.label: graphify-out/ knowledge graph
nodes.rationale: Concepts, screens, flows, decisions and the edges between them, each tagged as extracted or inferred; graph.html for a browser. Committed with its report, extraction cache and manifest so a fresh worktree queries the same graph without rebuilding.

nodes.label: .mcp.json (mempalace and graphify MCP servers)
nodes.rationale: Declares the two MCP servers, approved once per machine when Claude Code asks.

nodes.label: .graphifyignore
nodes.rationale: Generated tables and tooling are left out of the graph, so the graph holds the designed content rather than its derived forms.

nodes.label: MemPalace global hooks caveat (wing_api overwrite)
nodes.rationale: MemPalace's own global hooks in ~/.claude/settings.json (mempal_save_hook.sh and mempal_precompact_hook.sh) file a running session's transcript under the shared wing wing_api without naming the project; because MemPalace keys drawers by content and upserts, they overwrite the wing the project hooks set. The global session-end hook is project-aware, so a cleanly ended session does end up in ampm. Fix: point the two global hooks at the project-aware runner (mempalace hook run --hook stop --harness claude-code, and --hook precompact) and re-key what is already in the shared wing with mempalace wings split --wing wing_api (plan first, then --yes).

nodes.label: setup_memory.sh
nodes.rationale: On a new machine installs the two CLIs (MemPalace, graphify) at the tested versions with uv tool install and backfills the wing with the project's transcripts and docs.

nodes.label: Recording a confirmation from AMPM (procedure)
nodes.rationale: Open-item and log notes are written once and kept, so the confirmation is recorded in the open item's note (status: confirmed), then docs/decisions.json is updated, then apply_decisions.py, decision_log_build.py, decision_register_build.py, assumptions_sheet_build.py, vault_build.py and site_build.mjs (with --brief too) are run and the two shared pages republished; the next checkpoint commits everything and the vault follows.

nodes.label: reference_docs/ (the brief AMPM supplied)
nodes.rationale: The business explanation, the Why AMPM App note, the Developer Technical Specification v1.0, two Level-1 flowcharts, and AMPM's answers of 25 October 2026 in answers/.
